plan_delta.reason: The authenticated default Codex execution can run a read-only task, but its local CLI rejects the output-schema option. The schema remains the canonical verifier-output contract; enforcement moves from provider invocation to an immediate deterministic validator that implements every constraint in this frozen schema.
plan_delta.authority_scope: campaign-local verifier execution and validation configuration
plan_delta.owner: batch manifest and recorded verifier amendments
unchanged: the verifier prompt and its JSON-only instruction
the rule that a challenge or malformed result leaves the batch unverified

effective_validation.model_invocation: fresh ephemeral read-only Codex execution without the unsupported CLI output-schema flag
effective_validation.postcondition: The final message must parse as JSON and pass deterministic enforcement of every frozen verifier-output schema constraint before any mechanical reconciliation may consume it.
effective_validation.failure_behavior: A malformed, schema-invalid, missing, duplicate, or incomplete verifier decision is discarded as no verification output; no semantic reference may be verified.
